description: Resolve a token name or ticker to its mint by searching the Cookiescan registry (every Cookie Chain token) by symbol/name — partial and case-insensitive — or by mint prefix. Returns ranked candidates (most liquid first) with mint, price, liquidity, 24h volume, and holders. Use this FIRST whenever the user names a token but you don't have its mint, then pass the chosen mint to get_token_info / get_quote / trade. Multiple tokens can share a symbol — compare liquidity and confirm the mint before trading. No wallet needed.

query.description: token name, ticker, or mint prefix, e.g. "cookhouse"

name: search_tokens
title: Search tokens by name
